# OpenFoodTox - R package making OpenFoodTox data accessible in R

This R package provides convenient access to data extracted from some of
the spreadsheet files made available as OpenFoodTox, the chemical
hazards database of the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA). The
original files have been published under the [Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0
International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)
licence and can be accessed via the [EFSA
website](https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/data-report/chemical-hazards-database-openfoodtox)
or directly at [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/doi/10.5281/zenodo.780543).

The core component of the package is the data object `oft`, which
contains the data from four OpenFoodTox spreadsheets which are currently
relevant for our group at Agroscope. These are the spreadsheets on
substance characterisation, EFSA outputs, reference points and reference
values.

When using this R package, the data are available in the form of a
[`dm`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=dm) object. Basically, a `dm`
object is a list of tables with defined relations.

## Documentation

The online documentation is [available on
github](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/index.html).

A graphical representation of these tables and their relations and some
usage examples are shown in the [documentation of the `oft`
object](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft.html).
In addition, there is a [package vignette on the `oft`
object](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/articles/OpenFoodTox.html),
describing the contents of the individual tables.

For further information on relational data models as implemented in the
[`dm`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=dm) package, please refer to
its [online documentation](https://dm.cynkra.com/).

## Installation

``` r
install.packages("OpenFoodTox", repos = c("https://agroscope-ch.r-universe.dev", "https://cran.r-project.org"))
```

You can then load the package in R using

    library(OpenFoodTox)

to have the data object `oft` available.

# Package index

## Main data object

- [`oft`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft.md) :
  Connected tables of data published in OpenFoodTox

## Utility functions

- [`oft_group_species()`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_group_species.md)
  : Group species names occurring in reference points

## Utility data objects

- [`oft_aq_green_algae`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_green_algae.md)
  : Aquatic green algae
- [`oft_aq_diatom_algae`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_diatom_algae.md)
  : Aquatic diatoms
- [`oft_aq_cyanobacteria`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_cyanobacteria.md)
  : Aquatic Cyanobacteria
- [`oft_aq_macrophytes`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_macrophytes.md)
  : Aquatic macrophytes
- [`oft_aq_primary_producers`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_primary_producers.md)
  : Aquatic primary producers
- [`oft_aq_invertebrates`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_invertebrates.md)
  : Aquatic invertebrates
- [`oft_aq_fish`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_aq_fish.md)
  : Fish
- [`oft_earthworms`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_earthworms.md)
  : Earthworms
- [`oft_soil_macroorganisms`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_soil_macroorganisms.md)
  : Soil macroorganisms
- [`oft_birds`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_birds.md)
  : Birds
- [`oft_bees`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_bees.md)
  : Bees
- [`oft_arthropods`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_arthropods.md)
  : Beneficial Arthropods
- [`oft_mammals`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_mammals.md)
  : Mammals
- [`oft_plants`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_plants.md)
  : Plants
- [`oft_other`](https://agroscope-ch.github.io/openfoodtox/reference/oft_other.md)
  : Other
